missions.title: First Spark
missions.brief: Every element is defined by one number: its count of protons. Forge the simplest atom in the universe — one proton, one electron, no neutrons.

missions.title: Seal the First Shell
missions.brief: Shell 1 is tiny — it holds exactly 2 electrons. Give helium its full first shell and a nucleus of 2 protons + 2 neutrons.

missions.title: The Third Proton
missions.brief: Change the proton count and you change the element itself. Three protons make lithium — the extra electron starts a brand-new shell.

missions.title: Carbon Core
missions.brief: Six protons make carbon — the atom every living thing is built from. Forge carbon-12: 6 protons, 6 neutrons, 6 electrons.

missions.title: Oxygen, Two Short
missions.brief: Oxygen has 8 electrons but shell 2 holds 8 — count them: 2 in shell 1, 6 in shell 2. Two empty seats explain why oxygen pulls electrons from other atoms.

missions.title: Neon, Sealed
missions.brief: Fill shell 2 all the way to 8 and the atom is sealed — no seats left, no reason to react. Forge neon-20.

missions.title: Sodium's Lonely Electron
missions.brief: Eleven electrons: 2 + 8 fill two shells, and number 11 starts shell 3 alone. Forge sodium-23.

missions.title: Carbon-14, the Timekeeper
missions.brief: Same protons, different neutrons — that is an isotope. Keep carbon's 6 protons and 6 electrons, but pack in 8 neutrons. Archaeologists date ancient things with this exact atom.

missions.title: Sodium's Lost Electron
missions.brief: Atoms become ions when electrons are gained or lost. Take neutral sodium and remove its lonely shell-3 electron: still sodium (11 protons), but charge +1.

missions.title: Chlorine, the Electron Thief
missions.brief: Chlorine-35 has 17 protons, 18 neutrons and 17 electrons — one seat empty in shell 3. This is why chlorine steals electrons.

missions.title: Chloride, Sealed by Theft
missions.brief: When chlorine steals one electron it becomes a chloride ion: charge −1 and a sealed outer shell. 17 protons, 18 electrons.

missions.title: Calcium, Bone Builder
missions.brief: The fourth shell opens with just 2 electrons. Forge calcium-40 — 20 protons, 20 neutrons, shells of 2 · 8 · 8 · 2 — the atom of bones and shells.
